rules.summary: Use the first real compiler/runtime error as the initial root-cause authority; later undefined/uninitialized/ambiguous messages may be cascade.
Static/build PASS does not equal Houdini runtime PASS. A failed Build invalidates the generated output artifact for further authority.
After structural node changes, explicitly Cook when the network is expected to execute, and read host.errors on failure.
Use checkpoint=auto before structural/high-risk mutation; verify readback and rollback if validation fails.
Do not assume equal point indices across inputs; prefer semantic keys such as name.
Hierarchy mutations must consider descendants and downstream references, not only the directly targeted element.
Normal hou graph mutation executes on the Houdini-safe UI/main thread handoff; do not move it to arbitrary workers.
Command polling and result egress remain separate; the previous shared worker caused roughly 2.3 s extra result delay.
AI writes use optimistic concurrency: read -> hash -> write(expected_hash) -> readback. Hash mismatch returns CONFLICT with zero mutation.
For the validated KineFX point representation, P is world joint position (vector), transform is world joint rotation (matrix3), and translation must not be extracted from transform.
procedure: read rotation from transform as matrix3
keep position and rotation types separate

rules.summary: Before point()/prim()/detail() values enter overloaded functions, matrix math, quaternion, sprintf, normalize, dot/cross, or lerp, assign them to explicitly typed temporaries first.
Treat ordinary VEX function input parameters as read-only. Copy to a local variable before mutation; use export only for intentional writable outputs.
For hierarchical or recursive algorithms, compute into temporary arrays and commit setpointattrib writes after dependency evaluation; validate final writes in a downstream node.
Do not assume C++ syntax or APIs in VEX. Avoid redefining built-in macros such as PI, avoid unverified top-level const usage, and verify functions against the active Houdini VEX API.
Guard normalize, division, inverse, and determinant-sensitive operations against zero/near-degenerate inputs before execution.
HOM scripts must explicitly validate required nodes and required parameters. Missing critical node/parm is a hard error, not a silent skip.
Before setInput, validate target input index, source node existence, and source output index against the actual node types; do not infer connector counts.
Do not assume collection helpers exist across HOM versions. Use APIs verified on the active Houdini version and make diagnostic-stat collection non-authoritative if an optional helper is unavailable.
Empty node.errors does not imply PASS. Relevant warnings, cook exceptions, missing output rows, or failed semantic checks can still invalidate the test.
Keep TECHNICAL_PASS and VISUAL_PASS separate. Finite/cook-valid/numerically-correct output does not automatically establish visual correctness.
A harness must fail closed on unhandled exceptions, missing expected rows/attributes, or zero-result diagnostics; never default these cases to PASS.
FBX animation export must verify the range mode itself is Custom/Animation Range rather than Current Frame; setting start/end alone is insufficient.
Batch animation import must read back the actual Animation FBX File parameter before Cook. Changing only the output filename does not prove the imported animation changed.

On Houdini 21.0.440, a force Cook under Manual Update may not execute as expected in some workflows. For test harnesses, temporarily enter Auto Update around the explicit Cook and restore the prior mode.
When constructing HIP CPIO archives, do not emit directory members such as obj/; directory entries previously caused Missing file extension load failures.
HIP archive member order for a node is significant. Preserve a validated order such as .init -> .def -> .chn -> .parm -> .userdata when generating archive members.
When serializing Python SOP source into .parm, decode the serialized parameter back to the real script and compile that recovered script before accepting the build.
Branches intended as static references must not retain accidental $F/$T dependencies. Freeze explicit frame/time values so full-range evaluation does not recompute invariant data every frame.

Complex VEX algorithms should emit bounded detail diagnostics for weights, ratios, counts, residual/error metrics, and unresolved elements so tests can verify semantics without relying only on viewport inspection.
Do not assume inspect.node name_with_category is a valid createNode/network.apply constructor token. Resolve and validate the constructor token against the active parent category first.
procedure: treat inspect.node type display/name_with_category as descriptive evidence
use network.validate with a unique probe name to verify the constructor token before promotion
store validated display-to-constructor aliases by host version

rules.summary: Use network.ensure_transactional / network.ensure_and_cook when the caller explicitly wants declared node parameters, state fields, and target inputs to converge to a desired configuration in one synchronous UI-authority transaction. Use parm.write/parm.batch_write or node.connect/node.batch_connect with expected hashes when the write must remain conditional on state observed by an earlier external read.
assumptions: Ensure only owns fields and target inputs explicitly present in the declaration.
Unspecified parameters, state fields, and inputs are preserved.

rules.summary: Use network.ensure_plan as a read-only advisory preview of the current Ensure diff. The compact/summary counts are authoritative for the returned snapshot even when detail rows are truncated. The plan performs no node creation, parameter/state mutation, connection mutation, or Cook. It is not a lock. For a guarded Plan -> Ensure handoff, pass plan_hash back as expected_plan_hash; mismatch fails with PLAN_CONFLICT and written=0 before mutation.
assumptions: Plan and Ensure share the same declarative node/connection contract.
plan_hash binds the declaration plus the observed declared-state diff and is independent of max_details truncation.
expected_plan_hash guards the handoff against declaration/state drift between Plan and Ensure.
Expected-hash parm/connection primitives remain the finer-grained authority for writes conditional on earlier external reads.
